def __init__(self, cursor, scenario_id):
    """
    :param cursor:
    :param scenario_id:
    """

    self.SCENARIO_ID = scenario_id

    def fetch_optional_feature(feature_name):
        return cursor.execute(
            f"""SELECT {feature_name}
            FROM scenarios
            WHERE scenario_id = {scenario_id};"""
        ).fetchone()[0]

    self.OPTIONAL_FEATURE_TRANSMISSION = fetch_optional_feature('of_transmission')
    self.OPTIONAL_FEATURE_TRANSMISSION_HURDLE_RATES = fetch_optional_feature('of_transmission_hurdle_rates')
    self.OPTIONAL_FEATURE_SIMULTANEOUS_FLOW_LIMITS = fetch_optional_feature('of_simultaneous_flow_limits')
    self.OPTIONAL_FEATURE_LF_RESERVES_UP = fetch_optional_feature('of_lf_reserves_up')
    self.OPTIONAL_FEATURE_LF_RESERVES_DOWN = fetch_optional_feature('of_lf_reserves_down')
    self.OPTIONAL_FEATURE_REGULATION_UP = fetch_optional_feature('of_regulation_up')
    self.OPTIONAL_FEATURE_REGULATION_DOWN = fetch_optional_feature('of_regulation_down')
    self.OPTIONAL_FEATURE_FREQUENCY_RESPONSE = fetch_optional_feature('of_frequency_response')
    self.OPTIONAL_FEATURE_SPINNING_RESERVES = fetch_optional_feature('of_spinning_reserves')
    self.OPTIONAL_FEATURE_RPS = fetch_optional_feature('of_rps')
    self.OPTIONAL_FEATURE_CARBON_CAP = fetch_optional_feature('of_carbon_cap')
    self.OPTIONAL_FEATURE_TRACK_CARBON_IMPORTS = fetch_optional_feature('of_track_carbon_imports')
    self.OPTIONAL_FEATURE_PRM = fetch_optional_feature('of_prm')
    self.OPTIONAL_FEATURE_ELCC_SURFACE = fetch_optional_feature('of_elcc_surface')
    self.OPTIONAL_FEATURE_LOCAL_CAPACITY = fetch_optional_feature('of_local_capacity')
    self.OPTIONAL_FEATURE_MARKETS = fetch_optional_feature('of_markets')
    self.OPTIONAL_FEATURE_TUNING = fetch_optional_feature('of_tuning')
